record.reason: Sparse neural networks have been proven to generate efficient and better runtimes when compared to dense neural networks. Acceleration in runtime is better achieved with structured sparsity. However, generating an efficient sparsity structure to maintain both runtime and accuracy is a challenging task. In this paper, we implement the RBGP4 sparsity pattern derived from the Ramanujan Bipartite Graph Product (RBGP) framework on various Computer Vision tasks and test how well it performs w.r.t accuracy and runtime.
